verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's cloud/coding agent (docs-3,6,8,14,15,16) supports assigning tasks that plan, execute, and produce PRs autonomously, with a workspace to track/review/merge—covering build+demo-for-review workflows, and automations can trigger tests via CI. However, there's no explicit evidence of built-in test execution or demo generation, and community evidence shows skepticism about autonomous 'fix the bug' workflows being unreliable/dangerous (comm-10), suggesting the end-to-end autonomous cycle still requires human oversight.
